overview:
Scholarship

Published over 300 Refereed Research papers concerning exercise physiology, exercise training, weight loss/weight maintenance, metabolism and insulin sensitivity.  Had sustained NIH funding for over 25 years.

Service

Senior Editorial Board JSCR, JSC, and J Phys Ed, reviewer for over 40 medical/biological science journals, coach of RPM Olympic weight Lifting, Consultant National YMCA, Member US Weightlifting Federation's Scientific Services Committee, Scholarship Committee NSCA, Research Committee NSCA, Consultant Sports Medicine Committee, USWF, NSCA Program Committee, Liaison Committee ACSM, Senior Scientist in the Center for Nutrition Obesity Research, Center for Aging, Center for Diabetes Research and Training, Center for Exercise Medicine  Executive Action Committee Nutrition Obesity Research Center. Center for Aging Executive Council.

Personal

I have been married to Becky Shoup Hunter for over 47 years and have two daughters and two granddaughters.
